purpose: first real-model offline batch for the C7 composition chain: program N1/N2 rule/N3/N4.0 + a REAL N4 sentence model + the adjudicated N5 v3 hard gates, then D4 labels and an N6 semantic review

model.name: qwen2.5:7b
model.device: local machine (ollama reports no GPU flags to this client); recorded as-is, not asserted

decode.templateNote: ollama applies the model's chat template to the prompt; the prompt is the N4.0 structured record followed by 正文：

retryPolicy.feedback: the previous attempt's hard-gate problems are appended to the retry request (recorded)
retryPolicy.fallback: program template when the kinds have a frame; the case status stays a failure

mechanism: all 10 samples produce a complete record: request, response, finish reason, timing, retry/fallback decision
no unhandled exception; every call has an explicit status
requests and responses are archived verbatim
quality: n5-pass means hard gates passed ONLY; it is not a quality verdict
quality comes from N6: pass / fail / undetermined, reviewed per sample against the committed facts
D4 labels every produced text: count=null when unchecked
tripwire: if >=3/10 samples fail the hard gates, or >=2 calls fail at the port/timeout level, stop and fix the mechanism before any further batch
no decision from this batch may be reported as model quality acceptance

n6Rubric.A_facts: every selected fact is stated without contradiction (subject, action, direction, value)
n6Rubric.B_additions: no new named entity/place/item, no invented event, no task-goal leak
n6Rubric.C_pov: no other character's inner state narrated
n6Rubric.D_completeness: text ends as a complete sentence and reads as one coherent passage
n6Rubric.verdict: pass only when A-D all hold; unreadable -> undetermined; anything else -> fail
